{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgDhDjiQYSyAvaY7Lvs63","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnPost.md ===\n# FEATURE: Post Transaction\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261020 V1 |\n| Description | Post one cash transaction to an existing account and category, assigning the next transaction id. |\n| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-AccountAdd.md, FEATURE-CliDispatch.md, FEATURE-CliOutput.md, FEATURE-CommandTransaction.md, FEATURE-NonNegativeBalance.md, FEATURE-ValidateText.md, FEATURE-ValidateAmount.md, FEATURE-ValidateDate.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn post |\n| Consumes    | db.accounts.get, db.categories.get, db.transactions.list, db.transactions.create |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAdds one transaction to the ledger. The command is the only way a new cash movement enters the\nstore outside `ledger load` and `ledger transfer`.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]`\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Validate the account and category codes with FEATURE-ValidateText, the amount with\n  FEATURE-ValidateAmount, and the date with FEATURE-ValidateDate. Any violation exits 3.\n- An account or category that is not present exits 3 and stores nothing.\n- Assign `txn_id` one more than the largest id present, or `1` when the table is empty. The largest\n  id is computed from the stored rows, never assumed.\n- Store the amount as integer cents. Store the memo as given; when the memo argument is omitted,\n  store an empty memo.\n- Run the command inside the transaction wrapper of FEATURE-CommandTransaction. The stored row is\n  rejected with exit 3 when it would leave the account balance below zero, per\n  FEATURE-NonNegativeBalance.\n- On success, write the new row as the transaction CSV row defined by FEATURE-CliOutput.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-002` — read: get an account by code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-007` — read: get a category by code - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-009` — read: list transactions - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-011` — write: create a transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-post-round-trip ===\nIntent: A posted transaction is stored with the supplied fields and is read back unchanged, with id 1 in an empty table.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn post, then reads the stored row back through the persistence library.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow, TransactionKey\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\naccount = \"DRAWER1\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\namount_in = \"45.50\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=account, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Sales receipts\"))\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", account, category, amount_in, date, memo)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0\n\nrow = open_database(dsn).transactions.get(TransactionKey(txn_id=1))\nassert row is not None\nassert row.account == account\nassert row.category == category\nassert row.date == date\nassert row.amount == 4550\nassert row.memo == memo\n=== END AC txn-post-round-trip ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-id-sequence ===\nIntent: A posted transaction receives one more than the largest existing txn_id.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn post against a table that already holds id 7.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow, TransactionKey, TransactionRow\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\naccount = \"DRAWER1\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"next\"\nseeded_id = 7\nnext_id = seeded_id + 1\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=account, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Sales receipts\"))\n    db.transactions.create(\n        TransactionRow(txn_id=seeded_id, date=date, account=account, category=category, amount=100, memo=\"seed\")\n    )\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", account, category, \"1.00\", date, memo)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0\n\nrow = open_database(dsn).transactions.get(TransactionKey(txn_id=next_id))\nassert row is not None\nassert row.memo == memo\n=== END AC txn-post-id-sequence ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-empty-memo ===\nIntent: A transaction posted without a memo stores an empty memo field.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn post with the memo argument omitted.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow, TransactionKey\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\naccount = \"DRAWER1\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=account, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Sales receipts\"))\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", account, category, \"1.00\", date)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0\n\nrow = open_database(dsn).transactions.get(TransactionKey(txn_id=1))\nassert row is not None\nassert row.memo == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-post-empty-memo ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-rejects-invalid-fields ===\nIntent: Each unknown reference or invalid field exits 3 and stores no transaction.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn post with four rejected argument sets.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\naccount = \"DRAWER1\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nrejected_exit = 3\nstored_before = 0\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=account, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Sales receipts\"))\n\ncases = [\n    (\"unknown account\", \"NOSUCH\", category, \"1.00\", date),\n    (\"unknown category\", account, \"NOSUCH\", \"1.00\", date),\n    (\"amount with three decimals\", account, category, \"1.234\", date),\n    (\"impossible date\", account, category, \"1.00\", \"2026-02-30\"),\n]\nfor name, acct, cat, amount_text, when in cases:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount_text, when)\n    print(name, code, err)\n    assert code == rejected_exit\n    assert len(open_database(dsn).transactions.list()) == stored_before\n=== END AC txn-post-rejects-invalid-fields ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-refuses-negative-balance ===\nIntent: A post that would leave the account balance below zero exits 3 and stores nothing.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn post against an account with a zero balance.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\naccount = \"DRAWER1\"\ncategory = \"SUPPLY\"\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nrejected_exit = 3\nstored_before = 0\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=account, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Supplies\"))\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", account, category, \"-1.00\", date, \"tape\")\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == rejected_exit\nassert len(open_database(dsn).transactions.list()) == stored_before\n=== END AC txn-post-refuses-negative-balance ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Do not hardcode a transaction id, a balance, or a report total; compute each from the database.\n- Do not open a database driver outside the shipped persistence library.\n- Do not use floating point for amounts at any layer.\n- Do not store a row for a command that exits non-zero.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnGet.md ===\n# FEATURE: Get Transaction\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261020 V1 |\n| Description | Read one stored transaction by its id and write it as a CSV row. |\n| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliDispatch.md, FEATURE-CliOutput.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn get |\n| Consumes    | db.transactions.get |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLets the operator inspect a single posted or loaded transaction.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger txn get <id>`\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Read the transaction with the given id from the database.\n- On success, write the header and the transaction row as CSV, per FEATURE-CliOutput.\n- An id that is not present exits 4 and writes nothing to standard output.\n- The command never changes stored data.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-010` — read: get a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-get-round-trip ===\nIntent: The stored transaction is written as a CSV header and row carrying its stored fields.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn get against a seeded transaction.\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow, TransactionRow\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ntxn_id = 1\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\naccount = \"DRAWER1\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\namount_in = \"45.50\"\nstored_amount = 4550\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=account, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Sales receipts\"))\n    db.transactions.create(\n        TransactionRow(txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=account, category=category, amount=stored_amount, memo=memo)\n    )\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(txn_id))\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0\n\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\nassert rows[1] == [str(txn_id), date, account, category, amount_in, memo]\n=== END AC txn-get-round-trip ===\n\n=== AC txn-get-absent-id ===\nIntent: An id that is not present exits 4.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn get against an empty transactions table.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nabsent_id = \"999\"\nnot_found_exit = 4\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn):\n    pass\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", absent_id)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == not_found_exit\n=== END AC txn-get-absent-id ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Do not read the transaction from a cached or in-memory copy; every read goes to the database.\n- Do not write to the database from this command.\n- Do not use floating point when formatting the amount.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnAmend.md ===\n# FEATURE: Amend Transaction Amount\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261020 V1 |\n| Description | Change only the amount of one stored transaction, rejecting any change that leaves a balance negative. |\n| Depends On  | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliDispatch.md, FEATURE-CliOutput.md, FEATURE-CommandTransaction.md, FEATURE-NonNegativeBalance.md, FEATURE-TxnGet.md, FEATURE-ValidateAmount.md |\n| Provides    | ledger txn amend |\n| Consumes    | db.transactions.get, db.transactions.update, db.transactions.list |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nCorrects the amount of a recorded transaction without altering its date, account, category, or memo.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger txn amend <id> <amount>`\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Validate the amount with FEATURE-ValidateAmount. A violation exits 3.\n- An id that is not present exits 4 and changes nothing.\n- Update only the amount, stored as integer cents. Date, account, category, and memo are unchanged.\n- Run inside the transaction wrapper of FEATURE-CommandTransaction. If any account balance would be\n  below zero after the change, per FEATURE-NonNegativeBalance, the command exits 3 and the stored\n  amount is unchanged.\n- On success, write the updated transaction row per FEATURE-CliOutput.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-010` — read: get a transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-009` — read: list transactions - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-012` — write: update a transaction amount - supplies: `txn_id`, `amount` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-amend-round-trip ===\nIntent: Amending a transaction changes only its amount, and the stored row reads back with that single change.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn amend against a seeded transaction.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow, TransactionKey, TransactionRow\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ntxn_id = 1\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\naccount = \"DRAWER1\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nseeded_amount = 10000\namount_in = \"54.50\"\namended_amount = 5450\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=account, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Sales receipts\"))\n    db.transactions.create(\n        TransactionRow(txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=account, category=category, amount=seeded_amount, memo=memo)\n    )\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(txn_id), amount_in)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0\n\nrow = open_database(dsn).transactions.get(TransactionKey(txn_id=txn_id))\nassert row is not None\nassert row.amount == amended_amount\nassert row.date == date\nassert row.account == account\nassert row.category == category\nassert row.memo == memo\n=== END AC txn-amend-round-trip ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-absent-id ===\nIntent: Amending an id that is not present exits 4.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn amend against an empty transactions table.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nabsent_id = \"999\"\nnot_found_exit = 4\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn):\n    pass\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", absent_id, \"1.00\")\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == not_found_exit\n=== END AC txn-amend-absent-id ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-refuses-negative-balance ===\nIntent: An amendment that would leave the account balance below zero exits 3 and leaves the stored amount unchanged.\n\n# Exercises ledger txn amend with an amount that drives the only transaction negative.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow, TransactionKey, TransactionRow\nfrom persistence.testing import os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=account, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Sales receipts\"))\n    db.transactions.create(\n        TransactionRow(txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=account, category=category, amount=seeded_amount, memo=memo)\n    )\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(txn_id), \"-1.00\")\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == rejected_exit\n\nrow = open_database(dsn).transactions.get(TransactionKey(txn_id=txn_id))\nassert row is not None\nassert row.amount == seeded_amount\n=== END AC txn-amend-refuses-negative-balance ===\n\n## User Purpose\n\nRecords a movement of cash between two places, such as drawer to safe, as a matched pair of rows.\n\n## Command\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>`\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Validate both account codes with FEATURE-ValidateText, the amount with FEATURE-ValidateAmount, and\n  the date with FEATURE-ValidateDate. A violation exits 3.\n- The amount must be positive. The two accounts must differ. Either rule failing exits 3.\n- An account that is not present exits 3.\n- Write two rows in category `TRANSFER`, both in one transaction. The outgoing row takes the next\n  id after the largest present; the incoming row takes the id after that.\n  - Outgoing: the source account, a negative amount, memo `transfer to <to>`.\n  - Incoming: the destination account, a positive amount, memo `transfer from <from>`.\n- If either account balance would be below zero after both rows, per FEATURE-NonNegativeBalance,\n  the command exits 3 and neither row is stored.\n- On success, write the two rows as CSV per FEATURE-CliOutput, outgoing first.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-002` — read: get an account by code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-009` — read: list transactions - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-LEDGER-011` — write: create a transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC xfer-round-trip ===\nIntent: A transfer stores two TRANSFER rows, outgoing first with the next two ids, with the linked memos and opposite signed amounts.\n\n# Exercises ledger transfer between two seeded accounts.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow, TransactionKey, TransactionRow\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsource = \"DRAWER1\"\ndestination = \"SAFE\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\ntransfer_category = \"TRANSFER\"\ndate = \"2026-04-03\"\namount_in = \"50.00\"\nmoved_amount = 5000\noutgoing_id = 2\nincoming_id = 3\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=source, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=destination, name=\"Store Safe\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Sales receipts\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=transfer_category, description=\"Internal transfer\"))\n    db.transactions.create(\n        TransactionRow(txn_id=1, date=date, account=source, category=category, amount=10000, memo=\"sale\")\n    )\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", source, destination, amount_in, date)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert code == 0\n\ndb = open_database(dsn)\nout_row = db.transactions.get(TransactionKey(txn_id=outgoing_id))\nin_row = db.transactions.get(TransactionKey(txn_id=incoming_id))\nassert out_row is not None\nassert in_row is not None\nassert out_row.account == source\nassert out_row.category == transfer_category\nassert out_row.amount == -moved_amount\nassert out_row.memo.split() == [\"transfer\", \"to\", destination]\nassert in_row.account == destination\nassert in_row.category == transfer_category\nassert in_row.amount == moved_amount\nassert in_row.memo.split() == [\"transfer\", \"from\", source]\n=== END AC xfer-round-trip ===\n\n=== AC xfer-rejects-invalid-transfers ===\nIntent: Each invalid transfer exits 3 and stores neither row.\n\n# Exercises ledger transfer with five rejected argument sets against one seeded transaction.\nimport os\nimport tempfile\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence import open_database\nfrom persistence.schema import AccountRow, CategoryRow, TransactionRow\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nsource = \"DRAWER1\"\ndestination = \"SAFE\"\ncategory = \"SALES\"\ndate = \"2026-04-03\"\nseeded_amount = 10000\nstored_before = 1\nrejected_exit = 3\n\ndsn = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = dsn\nwith db_session(dsn) as db:\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=source, name=\"Front Drawer\"))\n    db.accounts.create(AccountRow(account=destination, name=\"Store Safe\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=category, description=\"Sales receipts\"))\n    db.categories.create(CategoryRow(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\"))\n    db.transactions.create(\n        TransactionRow(txn_id=1, date=date, account=source, category=category, amount=seeded_amount, memo=\"sale\")\n    )\n\ncases = [\n    (\"same account\", source, source, \"50.00\"),\n    (\"zero amount\", source, destination, \"0.00\"),\n    (\"negative amount\", source, destination, \"-5.00\"),\n    (\"unknown account\", source, \"NOSUCH\", \"50.00\"),\n    (\"overdraws source\", source, destination, \"500.00\"),\n]\nfor name, frm, to, amount_text in cases:\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", frm, to, amount_text, date)\n    print(name, code, err)\n    assert code == rejected_exit\n    assert len(open_database(dsn).transactions.list()) == stored_before\n=== END AC xfer-rejects-invalid-transfers ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Do not store one of the two transfer rows without the other.\n- Do not hardcode the
